sections.content: How many students stayed in Ely after school?
Ely is a small town in the East of England. Ely does not have a university.
In Ely, [description of cluster]. In this analysis, we’ve referred to towns like this as 3.

How many students left Ely?

Of those who got degrees, 43% were living outside of Ely in 2018/19.

Of those who completed other post-18 education, 39% were living outside Ely in 2018/19.

However, some people who moved away from Ely stayed within the same travel to work area, a larger area that includes where most of the local working population both live and work. Of all graduates that sat their GCSEs in Ely, 69% remained in the same travel to work area in 2018/19, while 31% moved further afield.

83% of skilled non-graduates from Ely stayed in the same travel to work area in 2018/19, while 16% moved further afield.

23% of graduates were living in another English region in 2018/19.

7% of skilled-non graduates were living in another English region in 2018/19.
